_doc: Single source of truth for solver harnesses. run_one.sh reads this via conf.py (conf.py falls back to config.yaml:solvers only if this file is absent). Each entry: key = the arm name shown in the dashboard (MUST match web/index.html HARNESSES). guided=false -> objective has the '## Expert solution' section STRIPPED (blind FormulaCode: discover the optimization). guided=true -> full problem.md incl. the expert's merged patch, asked to beat it. The runner invokes:  <cmd> "<objective>"  inside a copy of the base_sha tree; the command edits ./vllm and exits. NOTE: claude's --allowedTools is variadic, so `-p` must be the LAST token of cmd: the runner appends "<objective>" and it becomes -p's argument.
